'''Kemla''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Dantus sector/Legends|Dantus sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
Several [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Kemla Yard|shipyards]] were located there during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|Republic assault ship]] ''[[Leveler]]'' visited them for a refit around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

==Appearances==
*''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]'' {{Ab|The Clone Wars: No Prisoners (audiobook)}} {{1st}}
